gizmo.title: Ithegi / Ipilisi
gizmo.description: Ileyibhile emile okwepilisi ecinezelekileyo enombala ogqamisayo okhethwayo, iqhosha lokurhoxisa, okanye ukutshintsha.

configure.title: Umbala ogqamisayo

configure.title: Umbala ogqamisayo ozenzekelayo
configure.description: Fumana umbala ogqamisayo kumbhalo weleyibhile ngokuzenzekelayo.

configure.title: Iqhosha lokurhoxisa
configure.description: Bonisa iqhosha le-icon lokususa/lokurhoxisa ngaphakathi kwepilisi.

configure.title: Ukufunda kuphela
configure.description: Fihla iqhosha lokurhoxisa ukuze ipilisi ibe yeyokubonisa kuphela.

advanced.title: Iyatshintsha
advanced.description: Yenza ipilisi itshintshe ivule/ivale xa iqhosha licofwa.
